program.title: Boxing Beginner S&C Week 1: Shoulder Stability & Stance Strength Foundation

athlete_analysis.profile_summary: Beginner boxer, 1 session/week, 60min available, mild shoulder irritation from bag work. Needs foundational S&C to support stance/guard endurance and shoulder durability.
primary_constraints: Mild shoulder irritation limits high-volume bag work and overhead pressing
Single training day/week requires efficient, compound-focused programming
Beginner level demands safe progressions and clear movement quality
sport_demands: Postural endurance for guard and stance stability
Shoulder/scapular control and durability for blocking and guard recovery
Trunk stiffness and anti-rotation for punch power and defense
athlete_analysis.block_priority: Build bulletproof shoulders and trunk control before advancing punch mechanics and bag intensity. Emphasize lower-volume, high-quality activation and loaded carries to support stance recovery and guard endurance without aggravating current irritation.

blocks.name: Block 1: Shoulder Durability & Stance Strength
emphasis: Hip and glute strength for stance balance

weeks.theme: Shoulder stability, trunk stiffness, and single-leg balance foundation

workouts.title: Shoulder Stability & Stance Strength
sport_transfer: Stance balance via glute and hip extension strength
Anti-rotation trunk control supports safe hand return and footwork
workouts.why_this_session: Build shoulder durability and stance stability to support boxing guard and balance, while managing mild shoulder irritation with conservative activation and loaded carries.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Activate trunk and hip control without spinal load, prepare for stance balance work

warmup.name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
warmup.purpose: Build rotator cuff strength and shoulder control with conservative load to manage current irritation
warmup.load_guidance: Light dumbbell (2-5 lb) for high control; no pain

warmup.name: Dead Bug
warmup.purpose: Establish supine core control and low-back stability without spinal loading

main_work.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
main_work.purpose: Load hip extension to strengthen glutes and establish single-leg stance foundation for boxing footwork
main_work.load_guidance: Start 65-75 lb; add 5-10 lb per week if form stays tight and no knee pain
main_work.tempo: 2 sec up, 2 sec hold, 2 sec down

main_work.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
main_work.purpose: Train horizontal pressing with shoulder-friendly depth limits to build pressing strength without overhead irritation
main_work.load_guidance: Dumbbells 12-20 lb each; elbows touch floor at bottom
main_work.tempo: 2 sec down, 1 sec pause, 2 sec up

main_work.name: Reverse Lunge
main_work.purpose: Build single-leg strength and balance for stance stability while practicing controlled stepping
main_work.load_guidance: Bodyweight or light dumbbells (5-10 lb); quiet step, stable landing
main_work.tempo: 2 sec step, 2 sec descend, 2 sec stand

main_work.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
main_work.purpose: Train anti-rotation trunk control and pelvic stability for safe punching mechanics and stance balance
main_work.load_guidance: Resistance band or 10-15 lb cable load; ribs stacked over pelvis
main_work.tempo: 1 sec press, 2 sec hold, 2 sec return

cooldown.name: Suspension Trainer Row
cooldown.purpose: Reinforce scapular control and horizontal pulling capacity for guard recovery and back stability
cooldown.load_guidance: Adjust foot position to scale; keep plank line rigid
cooldown.tempo: 2 sec pull, 1 sec squeeze, 2 sec lower

cooldown.name: Dead Bug
cooldown.purpose: Cool down core and reinforce spinal stability after loaded session

injury_modifications: If shoulder irritation appears during warmup external rotations, reduce load by 50% and limit to 6 reps
If dumbbell floor press causes shoulder discomfort, pause set and reduce load by 25-30% or shorten range
If any movement triggers pain, stop set, assess position, and notify coach before next session

weeks.progression_rule: Establish baseline movement quality and pain-free load tolerance. Week 1 is assessment; progress external rotation volume and loaded carries in Week 2 if shoulder remains quiet.

program.nutrition_focus: Support recovery from strength work: post-session protein intake within 2 hours, maintain hydration during and after training, consistent daily carbs to fuel boxing practice.
recovery_focus: Monitor shoulder irritation daily; avoid heavy bag work on non-training days
Sleep 7-8 hours nightly to support strength adaptation and central nervous system recovery
Short mobility breaks (2-3 min) during sedentary hours to maintain shoulder and hip range
safety_notes: Mild shoulder irritation may worsen if loaded pressing or external rotation volume spikes; progress conservatively
Beginner lifter: prioritize movement quality over load; film sets 1-2 to check form consistency
No heavy bag work during or 24hr after strength session; allow shoulder 48hr between intense demands
assumptions: Athlete has access to dumbbells, resistance bands, and cable machine at gym
No medical imaging or formal diagnosis; managing irritation conservatively
Single session/week limits total volume; 60min session includes adequate warmup and cooldown
Beginner assumes prior S&C experience minimal; will follow coaching cues and pain-free range
Boxing practice (bag, pads, shadowboxing) occurs outside this S&C session
